entity.name: Jakub (jakcmencz)
entity.description: Independent maintainer from the Czech Republic. I design and test Sentinel-IR and sentinel-ir-mcp and approve every release; most of the code is written by an AI coding agent working from my specs, with every change going through tests and CI.

projects.name: Sentinel-IR
projects.description: Static analyzer that turns JavaScript, TypeScript, Python and Rust files into a small structural IR for AI agents and reviewers: risk level, network, filesystem, process, env and crypto calls, routes, native code and Rust build-time risk, with line numbers. It never runs the analyzed code.

projects.name: sentinel-ir-mcp
projects.description: Read-only MCP server that gives AI coding agents Sentinel-IR facts about a project instead of raw source. It cannot write files, run code or leave the allowed folders, and it can keep an opt-in audit log of what the agent read without storing source.
